nodes.title: Decode
widgets_values:
## Decode

Float32 VAE decode → crop the padding back off (Pad Image centres it, so the crop offset is half the padding) → drop the frozen frames.

**Convert Image Color Space**:
- ACEScct → `linear ACEScg` (scene-linear AP1) for the EXR.
- ACEScg → `HDR` (Rec.2020 HLG) for the video.

nodes.title: Save HDR
widgets_values:
## Save HDR

1. **Save Image (Advanced)** EXR `linear ACEScg` — JPEG thumbs, sun HDR viewer, Download images zip. Needs ComfyUI with ACEScg + `--enable-assets`.
2. **HLG video**: Create Video (`HDR`, source audio) → Save Video (10-bit; auto = H.264, AV1 also available). Core HLG uses 1.0 = 203 nits and clips above 1000 nits.

nodes.title: Preprocess
widgets_values:
## Preprocess

Guide = ACEScct-mapped SDR (mirror-padded to a multiple of 32 and freeze-padded to 8k+1 frames; cropped and trimmed back after decode).
Conditioning = scene embeddings.
Video-only latent (no audio stream), matching the `hdr_ic_lora` pipeline. The original soundtrack is muxed on save when present.

nodes.title: Model Links
widgets_values:
## Model Links

**LTX-2.5 Model Weights**

Make sure to click the "Agree and Access" button the first time you download.

- [ Distilled model - ltx-2.5-22b-distilled-transformer-bf16.safetensors ](https://huggingface.co/Lightricks/LTX-2.5/blob/main/diffusion_models/ltx-2.5-22b-distilled-transformer-bf16.safetensors)

- [ SDR→HDR IC-LoRA - ltx-2.5-22b-ic-lora-sdr-to-hdr-1.0.safetensors ](https://huggingface.co/Lightricks/LTX-2.5-22b-IC-LoRA-SDR-To-HDR/blob/main/ltx-2.5-22b-ic-lora-sdr-to-hdr-1.0.safetensors)

- [ Scene embeddings - ltx-2.5-22b-ic-lora-sdr-to-hdr-scene-emb.safetensors ](https://huggingface.co/Lightricks/LTX-2.5-22b-IC-LoRA-SDR-To-HDR/blob/main/ltx-2.5-22b-ic-lora-sdr-to-hdr-scene-emb.safetensors)

- Video VAE - one of these:
  - [ Diffusion decoder ltx-2.5-video-vae-bf16.safetensors ](https://huggingface.co/Lightricks/LTX-2.5/blob/main/vae/ltx-2.5-video-vae-bf16.safetensors) - Best quality
  - [ Convolutional decoder - ltx-2.5-video-vae-conv-bf16.safetensors ](https://huggingface.co/Lightricks/LTX-2.5/blob/main/vae/ltx-2.5-video-vae-conv-bf16.safetensors) - Lower memory & faster

This workflow uses fixed scene embeddings (no Gemma text encoder).

```
├── 📂 models/
│   ├── 📂 embeddings/
│   │      └── ltx-2.5-22b-ic-lora-sdr-to-hdr-scene-emb.safetensors
│   ├── 📂 loras/
│   │      └── ltx-2.5-22b-ic-lora-sdr-to-hdr-1.0.safetensors
│   ├── 📂 diffusion_models/
│   │      └── ltx-2.5-22b-distilled-transformer-bf16.safetensors
│   ├── 📂 vae/
│   │      └── ltx-2.5-video-vae-conv-bf16.safetensors / ltx-2.5-video-vae-bf16.safetensors
```

nodes.title: Source video → guide frames
widgets_values:
## Source Video (SDR→HDR)

Decode the SDR MP4, then **Pad Image** (`pad to multiple` 32, `mirror image`) in sRGB: no resizing, and the padding is split evenly between opposite sides. **Convert Image Color Space** (`sRGB` → `HDR ACEScct`) maps it to the IC-LoRA working space. Generation size follows **Padded size**; **Source size** goes to Decode, which crops the padding back off. Then the last frame is frozen and appended until the clip reaches the next 8k+1 frame count; `source_length` drops those frames after decode. Do not use Convert SDR to HDR (Lottes) — that is a creative HLG expand, not the IC-LoRA working-space IDT.
